positive_activation: A request matching Use when creating, migrating, validating, or auditing repository AI skills.
A request requiring a documented outcome in the skill-validation router or its topical references.
negative_activation: An unrelated request outside the skill-validation trigger family.
A generic repository request that requires no specialized skill workflow.
neighboring_skill_discrimination: Distinguish skill-validation from adjacent canonical skills and load only references required by the requested outcome.
workflow_application: Apply skill-validation through its canonical router and all selected reference verification rules.
Save a durable, status-labelled Superpowers plan before drafting or sending an approval prompt, including Reply approve and I'll implement.
Before requesting user approval for a requested change, save a durable, status-labelled Superpowers plan with granular, individually checkable implementation and validation items.
When a user explicitly asks to write, create, prepare, or make a plan, save that plan in the same turn even when implementation is not requested.
Treat a request to plan and implement, or an equivalent combined request, as explicit implementation authority after the durable plan is saved; do not request a duplicate approval.
Require a traceability table, concrete examples, granular checkboxes, delegation schedule, and completion reconciliation in a requested plan.
failure_or_edge_case: Follow an exception, prohibition, recovery, or safety rule from the selected topical reference.

Must not start, resume, assign work to, or message a subagent unless the current user request explicitly authorizes subagent delegation. A plan, plan approval, or general implementation approval does not authorize delegation.
Delegate translation work only after English is frozen and locale ownership is disjoint; never race a shared locale file.
Run two isolated full-suite workers only after test environment and default application environment isolation is proven.
Keep a task active through plan and approval checkpoints; use commentary for non-terminal updates and a final response only after verified completion or a genuine blocker.
When approval is pending, retain the proposed plan and do not begin approval-gated work; after approval, resume from that plan and mark items complete only with executable evidence.
Ask for approval only when the user requested solely a plan or design, or when a material decision remains unresolved.
A focused suite is green but make test fails after PHPUnit: lead with FAILED and the failed phase, not a qualified task-complete claim.
No fresh canonical result exists after the final executable edit: report NOT RUN as unresolved and never reuse old successful reports.
reference_validation: Confirm expected_references exactly matches the directly linked topical Markdown references and no forbidden reference is loaded.
